- Wants hosted API (no infra ops). Prefers public cloud; not interested in VPC or on-prem.
- Primary workload: chat UI with summarization fallback and small vector search for contextual replies. Expect low qps (~0.2 r/s average) but occasional bursts from demo days.
- Model preference: small/medium open-ish models; happy to use quantized variants. Interested in a cheaper fallback model for cost control.
- Latency target: ~300-500ms p50 for simple prompts; okay if p95 higher during bursts.
